* Alchemy: 47
* Astrology: 32
* Falconry: 37
* Logic: 89
* Music: 56
* Swordsmanship: 35

* Xylomancy: 34

What was their mean score?

Including the 1 preceding the decimal, what is the mode of the first 21 digits of $\Phi$?

|---------|------|------|
| Control | 14 | 0 |
| A | 9 | 4 |
| B | 11 | 8 |
| C | 6 | 16 |
| D | 15 | 32 |
